Truck Tire Financing in Southwest Florida

Keep the truck rolling now, pay over time. Credit-challenged options available.

(239) 314-8100 Get a Free Quote

Quick answer

Xpress Tire Center offers tire financing so owner-operators and small fleets can replace tires without draining working capital. Applications take a few minutes, approvals are common for credit-challenged applicants, and lease-to-own options are available. Fleet cards (Comdata, EFS, T-Chek) and national accounts are also accepted. Apply at (239) 314-8100.

What is included

  • Minutes to apply, decision before the truck leaves
  • Options for credit-challenged owner-operators
  • Lease-to-own and 90-day purchase paths
  • Fleet cards and national accounts accepted
  • Net-30 terms available to approved fleet accounts

Where we provide this service

We provide tire financing in Lehigh Acres, Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero, Immokalee, Punta Gorda and along the entire I-75 corridor between mile markers 80 and 161.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a semi truck tire cost in Fort Myers?

In the Fort Myers and Lehigh Acres market, a new tier-one 11R22.5 drive tire generally runs several hundred dollars installed, value-brand new tires run meaningfully less, retreads typically save 30 to 50 percent versus a comparable new tire, and inspected used tires are the lowest-cost option. Xpress Tire Center quotes mounted, balanced and disposed pricing over the phone at (239) 314-8100 so there is no surprise at the counter.

Do you offer tire financing for owner-operators with bad credit?

Yes. Xpress Tire Center offers tire financing including lease-to-own and 90-day purchase options, and approvals are common for credit-challenged owner-operators because the decision is not based on credit score alone. Applications take a few minutes and a decision usually comes back before the truck leaves the lot.

Do you accept Comdata, EFS and fleet cards?

Yes. Xpress Tire Center accepts Comdata, EFS and T-Chek fleet cards, major credit cards, checks from approved accounts, and national account billing, both at the shop in Lehigh Acres and on the shoulder during road service calls. Approved fleet accounts can also run net-30 consolidated invoicing.
